title: Branch Office Network
description: A Cisco Packet Tracer branch-office network lab with two interconnected switches and endpoint devices separated into VLAN 10 and VLAN 20.
features: Separates endpoint groups into VLAN 10 and VLAN 20.
Connects the two switches with an inter-switch link.
Shows IPv4 addressing for end devices in both VLANs.
